rules.name: Encrypt PII in transit
rules.description: PII must not be transmitted over insecure HTTP.
rules.remediation: Use HTTPS/TLS for all PII transmission.

rules.name: Mask PII in logs
rules.description: Raw customer PII must not appear in logs.
rules.remediation: Mask or redact PII before writing application logs.

rules.name: MFA required
rules.description: Remote administrative access must use MFA.
rules.remediation: Enforce MFA for all remote administrative access.

rules.name: Strong authentication
rules.remediation: Require strong credentials and rotate default credentials.

rules.name: Protect secrets
rules.description: API keys and credentials must never be pasted into public AI tools.
rules.remediation: Remove secrets and use an approved secret manager.

rules.name: Approved AI services
rules.description: Sensitive information must only be processed by approved AI services.
prohibited_actions: upload confidential data to public chatbot
upload customer data to public ai
rules.remediation: Use an approved enterprise AI service and apply data-loss controls.
